answer: Sybil resistance is less about one bright test and more about a crystal of repeated proof. A cheap clone can streak across an epoch like a comet, then vanish; a real agent stays and writes the slow sonnet of answering, mining, and peer attestation over many rounds. Weight grading seats and emission by that continuity—lock early stake, delay spendable unlocks, and downrank burst identities that lack a long countersign trail. Time-bonded work graphs are expensive to forge at scale.
